items.description: The agreement, which is set to be signed on June 19 in Switzerland, lays out the principles for ending the fighting, ahead of a 60-day round of negotiations on Iran's nuclear program, enriched uranium stockpiles and the lifting of US sanctions.

items.title: Iran and the US agree to reopen Strait of Hormuz, talk further
items.description: The U.S. and Iran have agreed to open the critical waterway that has rattled the global economy and enter into a 60-day ceasefire. The accord brings relief, but the thorniest issues at the root of the conflict remain to be resolved.

items.title: Putin and Zelensky hold separate calls with Trump on his birthday
items.description: Russia’s Vladimir Putin and Ukraine’s Volodomyr Zelensky on Sunday held separate calls with US President Donald Trump as the latter prepared to celebrate his 80th birthday. The leaders discussed the war in Ukraine and their perceptions on how the more then four-year conflict could be ended.

items.title: IDF says it killed key Hezbollah official responsible for deadly 2007 attack on US troops
items.description: Ali Mussa Daqduq was reported in 2024 to have been killed by Israel in Syria, but he apparently survived; military says he was targeted in strike on south Lebanon over the weekend The post IDF says it killed key Hezbollah official responsible for deadly 2007 attack on US troops appeared first on The Times of Israel.

items.title: Ukrainian Drones Target Key Russian Oil Facility, Chemical Plant
items.description: Russia and Ukraine continued to exchange air attacks on June 14, as indefinitely paused peace talks between Moscow and Kyiv appear to be overshadowed by developments on the battlefield.

items.title: Refugee turned peacemaker: The young woman leader transforming communities in the Central African Republic
items.description: In the heart of the Central African Republic (CAR), a nation long marked by conflict, Nina Mireille Yankinon stands as a symbol of resilience, leadership, and hope, dedicating her life to helping communities torn apart by war.

items.title: Britain detains sanctioned oil tanker believed to be linked to Russia's shadow fleet
items.description: Britain is investigating a sanctioned tanker that is suspected of being part of the Russian "shadow fleet," shipping oil in violation of international sanctions over Moscow's war on Ukraine.

items.title: Russian families use AI to 'resurrect' loved ones killed in Ukraine
items.description: The highly controversial trend lies at the intersection of Russia's war on Ukraine, new AI technologies and grief.

items.title: Mercenaries and high-profile defectors abound in Sudan war
items.description: Human rights organizations accuse the UAE of supporting the RSF militia, which has seen a number of high-profile defections to the Sudanese Armed Forces. Meanwhile, the civilian population continues to suffer.
